name: Warrior's Terrace
summary: At Darnassus's eastern edge, Sentinels patrol the Warrior's Terrace and its fortified gate. The district houses battlemasters and warrior trainers, with open plazas for drills and duels overlooking the road into greater Teldrassil.

sections.title: Shield of Darnassus
sections.body: Sentinels guard Darnassus at the Warrior's Terrace, also called the Hall of Justice. Mounted on nightsabers, they watch the high arched gates for travelers coming from the Teldrassil wilds. In the open-air plazas, aspiring combatants drill beside seasoned veterans on dueling grounds and target ranges. Weapon smiths and armorers meet practical military needs, while battlemasters coordinate night elf forces across the wider world.

faq.q: What is the purpose of the Warrior's Terrace?
faq.answer: The Warrior's Terrace is Darnassus's military heart and its main defensive gateway. Martial trainers and battlemasters work there, combatants use the dueling grounds and target ranges, and Sentinels guard the eastern gate toward greater Teldrassil.

faq.q: Where does the road through the eastern gate lead?
faq.answer: The road through the eastern gates leaves Darnassus and reaches the forest paths of greater Teldrassil. Those paths connect the capital to settlement hubs such as Dolanaar and Rut'theran Village below.
Sentinels guard the Warrior's Terrace and its perimeter gates. Many patrol the terraces and gateways on armored nightsabers.

faq.q: Which other districts connect to the Warrior's Terrace?
aliases: how to get to warriors terrace
faq.answer: Bridges and walkways connect the Warrior's Terrace to the Craftsmen's Terrace to the north, the Tradesmen's Terrace to the south, and the Temple Gardens toward the city's center to the west.

angles.text: As a warrior training in the night elf capital, you can find martial instructors, dueling areas, and battlemasters at the Warrior's Terrace.
At the Warrior's Terrace, you can find blacksmithing trainers and forge facilities for crafting armor and weapons alongside the garrison.
